description: fvoci compression rules (D-77). PUT to /zones/{zone_id}/rulesets/phases/http_response_compression/entrypoint. The app already sends Cache-Control: no-transform on these paths, which stops Cloudflare compression; this rule says the same thing in the zone so a later setting cannot weaken the strong ETag used by If-Match. Static paths keep the default (Auto).

rules.description: Do not compress API and sign-in responses.
rules.expression: http.request.uri.path eq "/api" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/") or http.request.uri.path eq "/auth" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/auth/") or http.request.uri.path eq "/healthz"
